ownershipSources.label: fantasyteamadvice.com (3 free rows; beta, "directional")
ownershipSources.url: https://fantasyteamadvice.com/ownerships?sport=nfl (SEA @ DEN Showdown, DraftKings tab, UTIL and Captain table; read from the live page 2026-10-15 about 3:56 PM ET)
ownershipSources.note: The three flex figures differ (62.7 / 48.1 / 41.3), so this is not the identical-number placeholder of D60. The page labels single-game ownership as machine-learning-model beta, modeled from far thinner data than the main slate, to be treated as directional; 27 more players are behind the paywall. No injury tags shown. The page also has a FanDuel section for this game, not used. Disagreement with Stokastic on the same three players: Smith-Njigba flex 62.7 against 41.2 (captain 37.1 against 37.7); Darnold flex 48.1 against 49.1 (captain 18.2 against 7.7); Wilson flex 41.3 against 40.3 (captain 14.8 against 10.6).

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage falls back to the DraftKings average points per game, flagged "no projection", unless the CSV lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection stays blank; with no average it stays blank rather than zero.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

notes: Removed from the showdown as out or not expected to play (D45): Zach Charbonnet (SEA RB, OUT), Jadarian Price (SEA RB, IR), Robbie Ouzts (SEA RB, IR), Jonah Coleman (DEN RB, IR), Pat Bryant (DEN WR, IR), Jake Bobo (SEA WR, IR), Caleb Lohner (DEN TE, IR).
